local RS=game:GetService("RunService") local W=workspace:FindFirstChild("FantasySurvivalWorld")
local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.FieldOfView=55
for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end
pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("AnimCheck") end)
local dist={bat=9,rabbit=4.5,deer=7,wolf=7,boar=7,bee=5}
RS:BindToRenderStep("AnimCheck",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+5,function()
 local want=workspace:GetAttribute("AnimTarget") or "wolf" local hrp=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not hrp then return end local best,bd=nil,1e9
 for _,m in ipairs(W:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA("Model") and (m:GetAttribute("Species") or m:GetAttribute("MeadowWildlife"))==want then local d=(m:GetPivot().Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude if d<bd then bd=d best=m end end end
 if best then local p=best:GetPivot().Position
  local last=best:GetAttribute("_lp") best:SetAttribute("_lp",p)
  local fwd=last and (p-last) or Vector3.zero fwd=Vector3.new(fwd.X,0,fwd.Z)
  if fwd.Magnitude>0.02 then best:SetAttribute("_fwd",fwd.Unit) end
  local f=best:GetAttribute("_fwd") or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
  local lat=Vector3.new(-f.Z,0,f.X) local dd=dist[want] or 7
  local cp,_=best:GetBoundingBox()
  cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(cp.Position+lat*dd+Vector3.new(0,1.2,0),cp.Position)
 end
end)
